No. 1905/18 – WEDNESDAY, MARCH 11, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: LD/05/2007/MV/118C.

I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act. No. 28 of 1964. that the government intends to acquire the following lands which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land to be acquired: Public purpose means the land Acquisition for the Moragahakanda & Kaluganga Development Project.

The lands described below, shown in sheet No. 70 of supplement 23 in F.Topo PP 17 approved by Surveyor General dated on 22.05.2013, situated at Medpihila Village, Medapihilla Grama Niladhari Division in Gangala Pallesiya Pattuwa, Laggala-Pallegama Divisional Secretary’s Division, Matale District, Central Province.
Name of Land: Kendhagolla; Description of Land: Light Forest; Claimant: State; Possessed by: Palagas Gedara Upul Nandana Ariyathilaka of Koangahawela, Medapihilla; Extent: 0.1010 Hectare.
